### Global Metadata
A complete 90-second cozy rainy-day piece for a small Japanese town, soft and comforting, like watching rain from an engawa veranda. 68 BPM, F major. Gentle piano, pizzicato and soft legato strings, a clarinet melody, soft marimba droplets, a warm cello. Pure instrumental ensemble piece.

### Vocal Details
None. Instrumental only: clarinet and piano share a slow comforting melody.

### Timed Arrangement
0-16 seconds: marimba droplets and piano. 16-46 seconds: clarinet melody with soft strings. 46-72 seconds: piano takes the melody, cello underneath. 72-90 seconds: clarinet returns, calm. Keep tempo, texture and loudness consistent from start to end; no big climax. The piece must play for the full 90 seconds and must not end early, ending cleanly on the tonic so it can loop.
